title: Mimi’s Beach House | Gulf-Front Dune Allen Rental | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Escape to Mimi’s Beach House, a luxury 6-bedroom beachfront rental in the gated Vizcaya community on 30A. Enjoy private beach access, a resort pool, and stunning Gulf views. Sleeps 12.
description_expanded: Description: Mimi's Beach House by Royal Destinations Formerly Gigi's Beach House Location: Dune Allen Beach Address: 5055 West County Highway 30A, Villa 1011, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459 Details: Mimi’s Beach House (formerly known as Gigi's Beach House) is a breathtaking beachfront retreat located in Dune Allen, nestled within the exclusive Vizcaya community, known for its Mediterranean-style architecture. This highly sought-after neighborhood offers a secure entrance, beach chair service, and a heated pool complete with showers. This welcoming three-story coastal oasis features six bedrooms and five and a half bathrooms, providing ample space for your entire family. Tailored for water lovers, Mimi's Beach House includes a spacious deck off the main living area, perfect for gathering with family and friends or simply basking in the stunning views and the calming sound of the waves. Enjoy magnificent sunrises or sunsets while sipping your morning coffee or evening cocktail. As the day comes to a close, host an unforgettable family dinner with your loved ones. Mimi’s Beach House guarantees an unforgettable experience. Out your door, you’ll find a private beach where you can enjoy the soft sand and crystal-clear waters of Dune Allen Beach. When you’re ready to explore, everything is within an easy bike ride or a short drive. You can reach all the charming sister villages of 30A, Miramar Beach, or Destin within about twenty minutes. No matter which direction you choose, you’ll discover a variety of options. Home Highlights: - Distance to Beach Access: Gulf Front - Parking Spaces: 4 Spaces in Driveway - Dining Accommodations: 8 Dining Table / 6 Bar in Kitchen / Balcony Dining - Private Beach, Security Patrol Community Highlights: -Gated -Beachfront Community -Resort Pool Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 12 6 Bedrooms / 5 Full Baths / 1 Half Bath First Floor: - Guest Bedroom 1: Bunk Room (Twin/Twin), Shared Bath (Shower) - Guest Bedroom 2: Bunk Room (Twin/Full), Shared Bath (Shower) - Bonus Room, TV, Refrigerator, Living Space Second Floor: - Guest Bedroom 3: King Bed, Private Bath (Tub/Shower Combo) TV, Balcony - Open Concept Living Room, Kitchen, Dining Room, Half Bath, Balcony with Panoramic Gulf Views Third Floor: - Guest Bedroom 4: King Suite, Private Bath (Soaking Tub with Separate Shower) TV, Large Balcony - Guest Bedroom 5: King Bed, Private Bath (Shower) TV, Balcony - Guest Bedroom 6: Queen Bed, Detached Bath (Tub/Shower Combo) TV, Balcony - Laundry Amenities Include: - 6 Adult Bikes - Beach Towel Service Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
